config.maxIterationsHint: Hard cap on Loop Decider iterations — the loop stops when it's reached even if the goal isn't met. Prevents runaway loops.
config.timeoutHint: Wall-clock limit for the whole run, in minutes. If exceeded, the run is stopped and marked failed — a safety net alongside max iterations.
config.maxCostHint: Optional USD budget for the whole run. Checked BETWEEN steps (a step’s cost is only known once it finishes), so the loop stops before the next step once the total crosses it — may overshoot by one step. For non-Claude providers the cost is an estimate. Empty = no cap.

edgesHelp.label: How steps connect
edgesHelp.body: Arrows set the run ORDER, not data — boxes have no input ports and edges carry no parameters. Each AI Step automatically resumes its session (full prior context) plus a short summary of previous steps; nothing is wired by hand. The Loop Decider has two outputs: ↻ Continue (goal not met → loop back) and ✓ Stop (goal met → exit).

problems.MULTIPLE_START: Only one Start node is allowed.
problems.NO_END: Add at least one End node.
problems.ORPHAN: This step isn't reachable from Start.
problems.DECIDER_BRANCHES: Loop Decider needs a Continue and a Stop branch.
problems.EMPTY_PROMPT: AI Step has an empty prompt.
problems.EMPTY_COMMAND: Shell step has an empty command.
problems.DEAD_END: This step has no outgoing connection.

ship-and-green.name: Ship & Green
ship-and-green.description: Fully autonomous: implement the spec, verify, and refine (fix) on failure — looping verify → fix → verify until everything is green. No human intervention.

verify-pass.name: Verify Pass
verify-pass.description: Autonomous verify-and-fix: detect and run the project's build/lint/tests, then refine on failure — verify → fix → verify until green.

ci-watch.name: CI Watch
ci-watch.description: Poll CI checks on the open PR (the agent uses the repo's CI tooling) until every check is green.

lint-and-fix.name: Lint & Fix
lint-and-fix.description: The agent detects and runs the project's linter and fixes every issue, iterating until the codebase is clean.

type-safe.name: Type Safe
type-safe.description: The agent detects and runs the project's type checker and resolves every error, iterating until it passes cleanly.

coverage-climb.name: Coverage Climb
coverage-climb.description: The agent runs the project's coverage tooling and adds focused tests until the thresholds pass.

build-fix.name: Build Fix
build-fix.description: The agent detects and runs the project's production build and fixes compile/bundle errors until it is green.

deploy-check.name: Deploy Check
deploy-check.description: The agent polls the deployment/health status (using the project's deploy tooling) until the service reports healthy.

factory_implement.name: Implement
factory_implement.description: Fully autonomous: implement the spec, verify, and refine (fix) on failure — looping until all tests pass.

factory_batch.name: Batch Implement
factory_batch.description: Batch-implement all the rail's tickets at once, then verify + refine on failure until green.

factory_freestyle.name: Freestyle
factory_freestyle.description: Hands the spec straight to the model with full freedom — no pipeline, it works like a regular coding agent, then verify + refine until green. Claude only.

autoloop-tdd.name: Autoloop TDD
autoloop-tdd.description: A strict red-green-refactor cycle for {{spec.title}}: pin down each behavior with a failing test first, write only enough code to turn it green, then tidy up — repeating until the spec is fully covered.

e2e-until-green.name: E2E Until Green
e2e-until-green.description: Run the end-to-end suite for {{spec.title}}, diagnose each failing user-flow, fix the underlying UI or integration defect, and keep cycling until every E2E spec passes.

flaky-test-triage.name: Flaky Test Triage
flaky-test-triage.description: Re-run the failing tests around {{spec.title}} several times to separate genuine regressions from intermittent flakes, then repair the real breaks and stabilize or document the flaky ones.

independent-verifier-pass.name: Independent Verifier Pass
independent-verifier-pass.description: An adversarial verification of {{spec.title}}: re-run build, lint, and tests from scratch, trust only the raw command output (not any prior 'it works' claim), and surface or fix every gap.

post-edit-test-guard.name: Post-Edit Test Guard
post-edit-test-guard.description: After each batch of edits for {{spec.title}}, immediately run the narrowest set of tests touching the changed files — catching regressions the moment they appear instead of at the end.

post-merge-regression-guard.name: Post-Merge Regression Guard
post-merge-regression-guard.description: Right after a merge or rebase brings other people's work into {{spec.title}}, run the fast smoke suite to catch integration breakage immediately — before any new feature work starts on top of it.

pre-commit-guard.name: Pre-Commit Guard
pre-commit-guard.description: A safety gate for {{spec.title}} that intercepts every commit: run the test suite first and refuse to commit while it is red, so broken code never enters history.

visual-regression-until-match.name: Visual Regression Until Match
visual-regression-until-match.description: Capture visual snapshots of the changed UI, hunt down every unintended pixel diff, and self-correct until the visual suite is green with only deliberate design changes approved.

format-until-clean.name: Format Until Clean
format-until-clean.description: Apply the project formatter, mop up the handful of style problems it cannot auto-fix, and keep going until a fresh format run leaves the working tree untouched.

lint-typecheck-fix.name: Lint and Typecheck Fix
lint-typecheck-fix.description: Run the linter and the type checker, resolve each reported problem with the smallest possible edit, and loop until both gates come back completely clean.

a11y-audit-until-clean.name: A11y Audit Until Clean
a11y-audit-until-clean.description: Run the automated accessibility checks over the changed screens, fix the violations one category at a time, and repeat until the audit comes back with zero issues.

de-sloppify-pass.name: De-Sloppify Pass
de-sloppify-pass.description: After the feature lands, sweep the diff for leftover slop — debug output, dead branches, sloppy names, bloated functions — clean it up, and prove the cleanup did not break anything.

fix-ci-until-green.name: Fix CI Until Green
fix-ci-until-green.description: Pull the most recent red CI run on this branch, reproduce the breakage on your machine, patch the real cause, push, and keep cycling until every check reports success.

pr-babysitter.name: PR Babysitter
pr-babysitter.description: On a recurring interval, sweep the open pull requests you are watching and keep each one mergeable: revive red CI, rebase the ones that have fallen behind the base branch, and ping the stale ones — escalating anything a human has to decide.

pr-watch-loop.name: PR Watch Loop
pr-watch-loop.description: Poll the pull requests on your watch list at a steady cadence, summarize each one's CI and review health, and either knock out trivial blockers or surface what needs an owner.

pr-self-review.name: PR Self-Review
pr-self-review.description: Critique your own working diff the way a demanding senior reviewer would, resolve what you find, and re-review until a clean pass turns up nothing critical — before the PR ever leaves your hands.

spec-first-ship.name: Spec-First Ship
spec-first-ship.description: Drive a written requirements checklist to completion one item at a time — each pass implements a single unchecked requirement, proves it, and ticks it off — so the spec is the contract for done.

dependency-audit-weekly.name: Weekly Dependency Audit
dependency-audit-weekly.description: Each week, take stock of which packages have fallen behind, sort them into safe-to-bump versus risky, and hand back a clear upgrade plan you can act on.

dependency-upgrade-one-by-one.name: Upgrade Dependencies One at a Time
dependency-upgrade-one-by-one.description: Bump exactly one outdated package per pass, repair whatever the bump breaks, prove the project still works, and commit — far safer than upgrading everything at once.

knip-until-clean.name: Prune Dead Code Until Clean
knip-until-clean.description: Hunt down unreferenced exports, orphaned files, and dependencies nobody imports, remove them safely, and keep going until the dead-code scanner has nothing left to report.

docs-sync-after-edits.name: Sync Docs to Code Changes
docs-sync-after-edits.description: After a round of code edits, track down every doc the changes touched — README, API reference, inline comments — and bring them back in line with how the code actually behaves now.

security-audit-weekly.name: Weekly Security Audit
security-audit-weekly.description: Run a weekly vulnerability scan over the dependency tree, triage what turns up by severity and real-world exposure, and hand back a prioritized remediation plan.

npm-audit-fix-loop.name: Patch Vulnerabilities One at a Time
npm-audit-fix-loop.description: Clear high and critical dependency advisories deliberately — one fix per pass, each verified against the test suite — instead of a blind force-fix that can quietly break the build.

api-contract-until-match.name: API Contract Until Match
api-contract-until-match.description: Drive the implementation until its responses honor the published API contract, closing any gap between what the schema promises and what the handlers actually return.

openapi-sync-until-valid.name: OpenAPI Sync Until Valid
openapi-sync-until-valid.description: Keep the OpenAPI document well-formed and faithful to the real route handlers, repairing spec errors and code-vs-doc drift on each pass until the linter is satisfied.

migration-until-applied.name: Migration Until Applied
migration-until-applied.description: Bring the database schema forward cleanly: run the pending migrations, repair any schema or SQL faults they surface, and confirm migration history stays consistent.

bundle-size-budget.name: Bundle Size Budget
bundle-size-budget.description: Land the feature without inflating the client bundle past its budget — measure each pass and trim, code-split, or lazy-load until the size gate is green.

changelog-sync-after-ship.name: Changelog Sync After Ship
changelog-sync-after-ship.description: After shipping, make sure the changelog tells the user-facing story: review what landed, write Keep-a-Changelog entries, and confirm nothing visible was missed.

guardrails-learning-loop.name: Guardrails Learning Loop
guardrails-learning-loop.description: Keep iterating on the gates until they go green, but every time a check fails the same way twice, write down a guardrail note first so the loop never burns iterations re-attempting an approach that already failed.

ralph-story-executor.name: Backlog Story Executor
ralph-story-executor.description: Work a backlog of user stories one at a time with a fresh context each pass: pick the next unfinished story, build only it, prove the project gates stay green, commit, and mark it done before moving on.

investigation-script-loop.name: Investigation Script Loop
investigation-script-loop.description: Pin down a bug's true cause empirically: write a tiny disposable script that exercises the suspect behaviour, run it, read the real output, and refine the probe until the output itself proves the root cause.

reflexion-debug-loop.name: Reflection Debug Loop
reflexion-debug-loop.description: Turn a failing test green without thrashing: each time an attempt fails, record a short reflection to disk and consult it before the next try, so the loop never repeats a fix that has already been ruled out.

merge-conflict-resolver.name: Merge Conflict Resolver
merge-conflict-resolver.description: Bring the branch up to date with its target by rebasing, then resolve every conflict file by file while preserving both sides' intent, and prove the result still passes before declaring the branch current.

staging-smoke-test.name: Staging Smoke Test
staging-smoke-test.description: After a staging deploy, walk a fixed smoke checklist — auth, the core user paths, and key integrations — fixing the smallest issue each time something breaks and re-running until the whole checklist comes back clean.

deploy-verification-loop.name: Deploy Verification Loop
deploy-verification-loop.description: After a deploy goes out, poll the health and smoke endpoints on an interval, investigating and fixing or escalating any non-healthy response, and keep checking until every configured endpoint reports success.

factory_openspec.name: OpenSpec Lifecycle
factory_openspec.description: Ticket-to-archive OpenSpec lifecycle: generate artifacts (opsx:ff) → implement (opsx:apply) → verify (opsx:verify); on FAIL loop back and amend the same change, on PASS archive it unattended.
